en: Aaugh!

<CLT=cltMIND>The frightening atmosphere was so oppressive,
I let out a shout without realizing it.
What...is going on in here...?

So, um...this is a made-up story, but a brutal
murder supposedly took place here.

Please stop... If I hear any scary stories,
I won't be able to go to the bathroom alone.

Oh, but she say it made-up story...
So that mean it okay, right?
Aaugh!!!
Wh-What are *you* doing here!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma stared at me in silence,
then disappeared down the hallway.

...I suppose he wants me to follow him.
What could be down there?

This area...feel spooky...
Gonta scared, too...

It's okay...
The murder story was just made up.

Not just story...
Gonta just have weird feeling...

Maybe stain on that wall over there...is
blood...

It's just a stain... It's probably just 
staged, y'know?
Staged...?

Monokuma or the Monokubs probably 
just put it there to scare us.
R-Really?
<CLT=cltMIND>So the script has been flipped, huh?
Tsumugi, does this kind of stuff bother you?
Well, it's not that I'm okay with it...

It's just when it's so overdone like this,
it makes it seem fake, so I feel okay.

But Gonta... You were so reliable until 
just now.

I guess it's too early for you
to wear a tuxedo and mask.

Eh!? Oh, no! But tuxedos essential for
gentlemen...!

Tuxedos essential for gentlemen...
Gonta never gonna become gentleman...

Hey, so I'm just checking, but...
this *is* a school, right?

Y-Yeah...
At least, that's what Monokuma said.

This floor doesn't seem very school-y
at all, though, does it?
...I'm not sure what you mean by that.

I mean...this floor's atmosphere is completely
different, like it's a whole other building.

Making a building like this must've taken 
a lot of money and work...

And all the research labs are amazing...
How much money was put into this school?
And it was all built just for us...

They did mention that the labs were
so we could develop our talent.

You research your talent, perfect it...
That's kind of like a school, isn't it?

Then Monokuma really wants this to be 
a school where <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL> gather?

And yet, at the same time, they're trapping
us here and making us kill each other.

Yeah, it doesn't make sense. We were brought
here and then forced to do the killing game...

Umm...I don't understand at all. 
My plain mind has hit its limit.

What on earth is this 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Academy for Gifted Juveniles<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

What on earth is this 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Academy for Gifted Juveniles<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma is glancing back and forth
at me and the picture on the wall.
...Hm? This picture?
Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I see. It's not a canvas...
It's a pane of glass.
Perhaps...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe I should use that item I haven't
used yet on this.
Alright, it's worth a try.

<CLT=cltMIND>I held the hammer in my hand, faced
the glass in front of me...
<CLT=cltMIND>and threw it as hard as I could.

Just as I thought...
there's a hidden passageway here.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know what he's up to...
But this did really help us out.

<CLT=cltMIND>The passageway looked different than
the haunted house—more like a factory.
This is...eerie in a different way.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.

<CLT=cltMIND>This must be a door to an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
I wonder whose lab this is...
<CLT=cltMIND>I should look inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's the door to an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
From the look of it, I'd say it's for <CLT=cltSTRONG>Art<CLT=cltMIND>...
I should investigate a little.
<CLT=cltMIND>I grabbed the doorknob and turned it...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
Huh? It's locked?
Yup, seems like it. I guess we can't go in.

But why is it locked? The other <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Labs<CLT=cltNORMAL>
weren't locked...

Oh, by the way...this lab has some kinda
rear entrance at the end of the hallway...
But that was locked, too.

If both the doors are locked,
how are we going to get inside?

Nee-heehee... Don't give up just yet.
Cuz I have a secret techn—
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click!*

<CLT=cltMIND>As if on cue, we heard the metallic
click of a lock opening...
<CLT=cltMIND>and the door slowly opened.
Yahaaah! Can I help you?
Angie!? You were in here?

I feel weird chatting out here, so let's all
go inside already, okay?
<CLT=cltMIND>How pushy...
Come in, come in! Please come in!
<CLT=cltMIND>Ever polite, Angie invited us into the lab anyway.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*

<CLT=cltMIND>...It's locked.
I suppose I can't get in here.

<CLT=cltMIND>This door must be the rear entrance
to Angie's lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>With Angie inside, the room is locked.
We can't get in.

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll investigate what's at the
end of the hallway.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this...? It's like a hanging
scroll, but it's blank.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
